title.narrative: Promoting Networking within MAB and the WNBR

description.narrative:
In addition to MAB’s regional networks, the Programme works with a growing number of thematic networks that connect biosphere reserves and the wider MAB community around priority themes identified by Member States. This element will support engagement across the full spectrum of MAB networks and provide the technical, scientific, and coordination support required to strengthen collaboration, knowledge exchange, and capacity development.
The MAB Secretariat will also promote and strengthen the participation of MAB Youth in the Programme. For more than 30 years, the MAB Young Scientists Awards (YSA) have supported emerging researchers undertaking interdisciplinary work aligned with the objectives of the MAB Programme. In recent years, the scheme has been further strengthened through additional contributions from Monaco in support of research in coastal and marine biosphere reserves.
The knowledge and results generated through YSA-supported research will be disseminated and leveraged to strengthen the World Network of Biosphere Reserves (WNBR) and enhance the contribution of biosphere reserves to biodiversity conservation, ecosystem restoration, climate change mitigation and adaptation, and sustainable development. Efforts will also be undertaken to mobilize and progressively structure the growing community of YSA alumni, enabling their expertise, experience, and professional networks to contribute more effectively to the objectives and activities of the Programme.
